responsibility: Defines regression tests for the printf-style foreign format parser and translator, validating how this module recognizes escapes and substitutions, records parsed substitution structure and spans, iterates substitutions within larger strings, and converts supported printf specifiers into Rust format syntax while rejecting unsupported cases.
same_name_distinction: This `tests.rs` targets the `printf` foreign-format implementation specifically: its cases exercise `%`-based substitutions with flags, width, precision, length modifiers, positional arguments, and rejection of unsupported specifiers, unlike `shell/tests.rs`, which only covers shell-style `$` placeholders and escapes.
